title: Beltrame Costabili to Ercole I d'Este, three clear letters of 1493

steps.what: Retrieved the six full photographs attached to R1095-R1097.
Inspected each body and address/docket verso: continuous clear Italian with conventional chancery contractions; no cipher passage identified.
Compared dating clauses and photograph cards; retained source filenames and SHA-256 hashes; separated these clear letters from the earlier cipher correspondence.

Brice Dudout reports that every 1491-92 Costabili cipher despatch of catalogue 361 has a contemporary Este decipherment and that 1492 no. 8 is printed in Berzeviczy 1914. Concerns the six cipher despatches, not the three clear 1493 records of this folder. Not verified here.

outcome.method_basis: All three original bodies and their versos show clear chancery writing; no enciphered passage was identified.

credits.note: contemporary Este decipherments of the 1491-92 despatches; Berzeviczy 1914

outcome.notes: Direct manuscript inspection by this project, without an independent outside check. No decipherment or recovered key claimed.

prior.where: No edition used; these are clear originals.

human: Requested review of open catalogue ciphers and publication of verified results.
